about: The parts of the terminal plugin's texts that thimble browser uses (server/thimble_browser/prompts.py). Each part is a file under prompts/terminal/, a section of it and, when given, some of its bullets (counted from 1). `replace` and `drop` are the only changes, exact strings; tests/test_prompt_parity.py fails when the terminal's text no longer holds one of them.

citing.heading: Citing
replace: run `thimble resolve` on it before you use it
read it with `read_ref` before you use it
drop: `thimble coverage` shows what this session computed over, read, searched and did not touch.

replace: When the person reads the answer squeezed, mark words that stand in the squeezed text, since that is what they read.
in thimble's drawing toolkit, at most six lines, such as `return k.beside(k.text('**scope="module"** {dim:one cart per file}'), k.text('**default** {dim:a fresh cart per test}'), { gap: 4 })`
in thimble's drawing toolkit; thimble browser does not draw it yet, so leave it out
